intelligence.economy_brief: The OSRS equity market shows muted breadth with more decliners than advancers and negative turnover-weighted price pressure. Market depth is ample but spread dispersion is extreme, while the shallowest books are being nudged by fresh arbitrage flows ahead of the forthcoming routine update window.
intelligence.market_mood: Cautious/rangebound – liquidity providers are earning spread rent, momentum is soft, and participants are rotating into carry and low-duration instruments.
intelligence.regime: Normal patch-day cycle (not an update day); elevated stale share, tightest liquidity in micro-caps, and a thin but active arbitrage sleeve.
intelligence.research_summary: Signal-rich names (twisted bow, Tumeken’s shadow, Scythe) continue to attract flow; micro-cap dispersion remains high. The market is pricing in routine-driven reversion with selective carry trades.
intelligence.summary: Broad market is subdued with negative breadth and minimal price pressure. assumptions: Read-only replay; never touches live wallet state.
Uses 1-hour Wiki bars, so 5-minute flow is approximated from hourly volume and trailing activity.
Passive fills remain the deterministic expected-fill model used by the paper engine; this is diagnostic, not a claim about real GE queue fills.
The LLM semantic prior is disabled in replay so strategy diagnostics remain deterministic and reproducible.
The usual weekly update-window prior is evaluated at each historical replay timestamp rather than using the current live clock.
Universe is bounded to currently relevant/high-activity items, so results are a strategy diagnostic rather than an exhaustive historical backtest.
